scope: 24 additional meaningful body figures across eight Answer topics; shared source/card text unchanged.

placements.title: Bring your question into the light
placements.description: Beside a sunlit window, a woman studies with her book and notebook open. She gives the question time, trusting that honest understanding begins by listening carefully and seeking truth in the light.
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved asset in docs/topic-artwork-review.json. Caption and rendered placement require independent review.
placements.alt: A woman in a russet sweater holding an open book and writing in a notebook beside a window

placements.title: Grace that leads to discipleship

placements.alt: A close view of an open Bible, notebook, pen and ceramic cup, with a reader’s hand resting on the page
